name: Divider
description: Thin hairline separating content sections or list groups, horizontal or vertical, with an optional centered label.
notes: When label is set, root is replaced by a row (slot 'labeled': line, text style --text-caption color --color-text-tertiary weight semibold, line) with --space-md gaps and --space-sm vertical margin — recorded here as a variant swap rather than a second tree since the schema has one default tree. inset is a raw pixel left-margin passed through by the caller, not a token.
